Acme Capital Intern, London

Early careers

Our internships put students in a deal team for ten weeks. Interns reconcile trades for our portfolio companies, investigate breaks in their reporting and build the Python checks the team runs every morning, presenting what they find to the investment committee at the end of the summer.

We look for students in their penultimate year with strong attention to detail, data quality and clear communication with traders and engineers. Applications open in the autumn and we recruit on a rolling basis, so apply early.
